title: agent-resurrect resume --json
description: A resume request. action: printed (--print, exit 0), refused (exit 1 unknown agent, 4 needs-tty, 5 busy, 6 gone; the session and its resume command are still included), launch-failed (exit 1), launched (the process is replaced by the agent, so this is normally never printed). Nothing is ever launched without a terminal on stdin and stdout. On exit 3 (no such session, or nothing recorded for this pane) action and session are null.
